_comment: AI-Assisted: Claude Code (model: claude-opus-5) - Authored per data-model.md §4 and §4.1 (task T034), for curation/abilities/<faction-id>.json. Keyed per ABILITY, never per (datasheet, ability) binding: the export carries thousands of bindings over a much smaller distinct ability set, so keying per binding would multiply release 1's dominant editorial cost by roughly an order of magnitude for no editorial benefit (research D6). `summary` is authored from the mechanic in this data set's own words; machine paraphrase of the publisher's text does not satisfy reference-db-schema.md §6.1(2) and is prohibited. draft, in_review, and needs_rereview all BLOCK publication; approved carries forward untouched while mechanic_digest is unchanged, which is what SC-011 measures.
title: curation/abilities/<faction-id>.json

mechanic_digest.description: A KEYED, TRUNCATED digest (HMAC-SHA256 under a repository-held key, 128 bits) over the hard-normalised mechanic text, computed while that text exists only in ephemeral storage and then discarded. Keying matters: an unkeyed hash of a short, publicly known string can be confirmed by anyone holding the text, whereas a keyed digest can be neither inverted nor used to verify a guess (C6/R8).

digest_refreshed_at_version.description: the version id this record's mechanic_digest was re-baselined at (009 FR-028); written only when an approval is carried across a digest refresh

digest_refreshed_under_authorization.description: the named, dated Product Owner authorization record the re-baseline ran under (009 FR-029); one blanket authorization, cited by every refreshed record
